description: Eight stereo sample players in one module, each with its own trigger, start position, level, pan, on switch and pair of outputs, plus a stereo mix

params.text: Sets the level of that sample player, from silence to the full level of the file
Places that sample player in the stereo field, hard left through centre to hard right
When off, that player is silenced at its own outputs and taken out of the mix

inputs.text: A rising edge plays that file from the start position; it reads high above 2V and low below 0.1V
Sets where in the file that player starts when triggered, 0-10V from the beginning to the end; it is read at the moment the trigger arrives

outputs.text: The left channel of that sample player, after its level and pan
The right channel of that sample player, after its level and pan
The left channels of all eight players added together
The right channels of all eight players added together

notes: a player stays silent until a WAV file is loaded into it from the right-click menu, either one at a time or eight at once from a folder
menu: Interpolation — Off, or Linear (Better Quality), choosing how the samples between two stored samples are worked out
Load individual samples — the eight numbered items under this label each open a file browser for that player, and each prints the filename it holds
Load first 8 WAV files from a folder — opens a folder browser and puts that folder's first eight WAV files into the eight players in name order
